name: mark-translation
description: A browser extension for Chinese-English translation

scripts.build:firefox: vite build --mode firefox && node scripts/post-build.js firefox
scripts.build:chrome: vite build --mode chrome && node scripts/post-build.js chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd dist/firefox && zip -r ../mark-translation-firefox.zip . && cd ../.. && echo '✅ Firefox extension packaged: dist/mark-translation-firefox.zip'
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && cd dist/chrome && zip -r ../mark-translation-chrome.zip . && cd ../.. && echo '✅ Chrome extension packaged: dist/mark-translation-chrome.zip'
